# Ginger

deceased

## Overview

- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>

## Appearance

Ginger is a parrot featuring wicked golden eyes and gorgeous plumage. When ruffling his feathers, he resembles a mere ball of green and gold.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P37](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0037)_

## Personality

Ginger is a parrot who possesses a highly imitative nature, frequently mimicking the sailors around him. As a result, he swears terribly and maintains severe swearing habits that cannot be broken, despite some people's objections to them.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P10](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0010), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038)_

## Traits

- imitative  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006)</sub>

## History

Ginger was a parrot who was originally named and owned by a sailor, who sent the bird to his brother, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), while dying. Ginger lived with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where the local schoolteacher, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), frequently visited.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P2](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0002), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P4](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0004), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P7](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0007), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P8](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0008), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P9](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0009), +150 more_
